verdict.rationale: Alloy's transaction-monitoring workflows document applying policy logic and generating alerts or investigations when thresholds are met. Its webhook docs also reference manual review events, which together suggest policy-driven escalation of risky findings to humans. The evidence does not show that the agentic automation itself can be bounded by policy, or that ambiguous AI decisions are routed to a human instead of being actioned automatically. Missing for 10: documented policy controls that cap or gate agentic/automatic remediation actions, explicit routing of ambiguous or low-confidence AI findings to human review queues, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a ai-native, I can limit automatic remediation by policy and escalate ambiguous or high-risk findings to a human
